title: Ordinary scalar inverse image and its termwise comparison
statement: For a finite commutative ring R and a morphism p:X→Y of schemes, the realization equivalences E_X,E_Y of constant-coefficient sheaves [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] identify the intrinsic ordinary ring-module pullback L with the fixed-scalar inverse image A. Construct E_Y L ≅ A E_X as the inverse mate of the section-normalized direct-image comparison, and construct its termwise complex comparison. The two ordinary constant-ring direct-image functors are equal by the defining coefficient adjunction. A typed natural-transformation wrapper of the intrinsic signed-total comparison retains exactly the components of proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso inverse [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-tensor-descent-data].

source.place: Tags 00YV, 07A4 and 07A6; Ordinary scalar inverse image and its termwise comparison

proof.text: Identify the constant-ring structure map by applying the inverse law of the coefficient adjunction Hom equivalence. Unfold the two ordinary direct images and rewrite this equality.

Compose the inverse section-normalized realization/direct-image comparison with the direct-image equality. Its inverse mate is invertible because realization is an equivalence. Define the ordinary comparison as this actual invertible transformation and apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso to obtain the chain comparison.

Wrap the intrinsic signed-total comparison using the existing natural isomorphism whose inverse components are prescribed on every pair. Its component specification determines the natural transformation uniquely; extract that specification for the wrapper. This avoids repeatedly reducing large total-complex definitions in subsequent theorem types.

def finiteScalarOrdinaryPullbackComparison
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor ⋙
        proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R) ≅
      ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p ⋙
        (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor
